    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every branch is a real button labelled with its option and, where it applies, "the agent's pick"; shortcuts are set with aria-keyshortcuts
      - listitem: Flagged consequences are focusable and point to their note with aria-describedby (role tooltip)
      - listitem: The "Other…" field is a labelled textarea; it has no focus ring of its own – its outline darkens instead, so focus stays visible
      - listitem: Picks, instructions and the agent's answers are announced in a polite live region
      - listitem: The lines are decoration and hidden from assistive tech
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "A new decision grows in: the question first, then its branches and their consequences, each line drawing itself out a beat after the other"
      - listitem: Pointing at a branch lights its path and lets the others step back
      - listitem: A pick fades the other branches away; the chosen path draws on to its outcome – "Approved · running" or the agent's answer – then the tree fades and the next one grows
      - listitem: "\"Other…\" opens as a two-line field and glides taller as you write, up to three lines; its line stays put while it grows"
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything appears at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Built on a container query: wide, the tree runs left to right – question, branches, consequences"
      - listitem: Under 640px it runs top to bottom – the branches hang off a rail under the question, each with its consequences below it; nothing scrolls sideways
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Ask a real question in one sentence and give two to four options – the label says what to do, the effects say what changes
      - listitem: Write effects as plain consequences with numbers ("Refunds $147 · not reversible"); flag only the part that worries the agent, with a one-line note and, if you have it, a source
      - listitem: Mark at most one option as pick – the agent's honest preference; in a follow-up, mark one more and the pick runs through both levels as one route
      - listitem: Use a follow-up when the agent truly needs a second answer for that branch – not every branch needs one, and a branch without it ends right there
      - listitem: Brand logos are not part of the component – pass them as icon and apps (e.g. from Simple Icons)
      - listitem: For "Other…", treat the text as a new instruction for the agent and return its short answer from onChoose
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-dctc, e.g. --ui-dctc-link / --ui-dctc-link-pick for the lines
      - listitem: The icons are Hugeicons Free (MIT) – keep the credit comment when you copy the file
